title: Restart after the 200: reconciliation lost

trigger.detail: deploy or OOMKill between the response and the task

steps.happens: receipt saved in T1
reconciliation submitted to billingExecutor's in-memory queue
Stripe gets 200: it will not redeliver
the JVM stops before a pool thread takes the task
reconcileCustomer never runs
billing_customer keeps the old last_provider_event_id; nothing notices

because: the queue is in memory and the only party that could retry, Stripe, was already told 200

closes.change: persist the reconciliation as a PENDING row in T1 and let a job process PENDING rows

evidence.claim: work forked to an in-process pool inside T1
in-memory unbounded queue, no drain on shutdown
Stripe is answered before the task ran

finding.recommendation: Persist the reconciliation as a PENDING row in T1 and let a scheduled job process PENDING rows, instead of an in-memory executor.
verification: Stop the JVM right after the 200; after a restart the reconciliation must still run.

title: Commit fails after the charge; redelivery charges again

trigger.detail: connection lost or constraint violation at commit of T2

steps.happens: draft invoice written in T2 (not committed)
provider charges the payer; money moved
commit of T2 fails: the invoice row is gone, the charge is not
listener throws; SQS keeps the message
SQS redelivers after the visibility timeout
a second POST /v1/charges, no idempotency key: the payer is charged twice

outcome.what: the charge; and one charge has no invoice

because: an irreversible external effect sits inside a local transaction, and neither the consumer nor the provider call carries an idempotency key

closes.change: commit a charge-intent row with a client idempotency key before calling the provider
dedupe the consumer on the provider event id

evidence.claim: a redelivery makes a new invoice, nothing dedupes

finding.recommendation: Record a charge intent with a client-generated idempotency key and commit it before calling the provider; complete the invoice from the result. Until then, send Idempotency-Key on the charge.
verification: Make the commit of T2 fail after the charge succeeds and let SQS redeliver; the payer must be charged once.

title: Stripe retries the webhook: invoice and charge twice

trigger.detail: Stripe resends an event whose 200 came too late

steps.happens: Stripe sends the same invoice event a second time
a second receipt row: nothing looks up the event id
the invoice event goes to the queue again
the consumer creates a second invoice and charges again

because: the receipt is saved without a lookup or a unique constraint on the provider event id, so a retried event repeats everything after it

closes.change: unique constraint on billing_event_receipt.provider_event_id; skip a known event

evidence.claim: no lookup by the provider event id before the save

finding.recommendation: Make billing_event_receipt.provider_event_id unique and skip an event whose receipt exists, in T1 before the send.
verification: Deliver the same Stripe event twice, and twice at once; one invoice and one charge must result.

title: Charge webhook before the invoice commits

trigger.detail: Stripe reports the charge while T2 is still open

steps.happens: charge created at Stripe inside T2
the charge event reaches the webhook before T2 commits
the webhook only stores a receipt; it never reads the invoice row

because: the webhook handler stores every event as a receipt and forwards only invoice events to the queue; nothing on the webhook side reads or needs the invoice row to exist yet, so an early charge event changes nothing

evidence.claim: only invoice events go on; a charge event is just stored

title: Charge event cannot be matched to its invoice

trigger.detail: the charge's own event arrives on the webhook

steps.happens: charge created; Stripe will report it to the webhook
the charge event arrives with no invoice id the handler reads
it is only stored and reconciled; no invoice state depends on it

outcome.what: the invoice is marked charged from the call's own result

because: markCharged uses the charge id the call returned, so nothing waits for the callback to find its request

evidence.claim: the charge id comes back with the call
